curation.name: Stilts Walk 15 cm
curation.summary: Perpetual stilt-walking policy for the 15 cm hardware variant, entered upright on matching stilts; simulation-only per its manifest.
curation.details: Trained on Mjlab-Stilt-Flat-MicroDuck with action_scale 1.0. The manifest requires hardware modifications (printable stilt geometry from Vottivott/microduck-playground hardware/stilts) and a held-pose command review, so there is no generic install route. This entry pins the 15 cm variant artifact; each stilt height is a separately reviewed entry.
curation.notes: The package manifest is resolved and inspected; the held pose requires an explicit command and hold/unwind review. The registry records no independent hardware evidence.
